explanation: Napoleon lost his last battle at Waterloo, in modern Belgium, in June 1815. He spent his final years in exile on Saint Helena, a remote island in the South Atlantic.

claims.text: To 'meet your Waterloo' means to suffer a final, decisive defeat.
The phrase does not mean a lucky escape, finding true love or changing sides.
Napoleon's last battle was at Waterloo, in modern Belgium, in June 1815.
Napoleon spent his final years in exile on Saint Helena, an island in the South Atlantic.
